description_en: Modifies the attributes of a reserved instance, including its name and description
description_zh: 本接口用于修改一张预留实例券的属性信息，包括名称和描述
kebab_example: aliyun ecs modify-reserved-instance-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --reserved-instance-id ecsri-uf61hdhue4kcorqsk0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyReservedInstanceAttribute

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the resource
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the reserved instance
parameters.name: reserved_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the reserved instance. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 预留实例券的名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: reserved_instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the reserved instance. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

Default value: empty
parameters.help_zh:
预留实例券的描述。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。

默认值：空
parameters.name: description

Message.description_en: The error message returned for the instance operation. A return value of Success indicates success. For more information, see the error codes section
Message.description_zh: 实例操作返回错误信息。返回值Success为成功，更多请参见下文错误码列表
